method: Manual CUA input and visual inspection; fresh task copies of the named A1200 configuration.

file is not executable; failed returncode 10. Subsequent keys went to this output window; reset rather than continue blind.

Building executable, 4% observed.

observations.result: Blank Sourcecode View remained; no waiting-state greeting observed.

Hello from Blitz! and Compiled, not interpreted.; Program terminated.; Press <ENTER> to return to the IDE ... . Recovery rerun observed.

observations.result: Metadata hidden in PED; debugger flag changed from light to dark. Filename initially typed with shifted characters; explicit both-shift chord/release then clearing filename restored plain.ab3.
Building executable observed.

observations.action: Inspect RuntimeDebug=0 build before guest click, using emulator menu only
observations.result: AmiBlitz3 Console Output showed Hello from Blitz! and Compiled, not interpreted.; no termination message. Waiting output observed.
Program terminated.; Press <ENTER> to return to the IDE ...; PED restored after Return.

observations.action: Insert Edited inside first string in PED and compile
observations.result: Console showed Edited Hello from Blitz! and Compiled, not interpreted. before any guest click.

observations.action: Return through termination prompt; add trailing + to first line and compile
observations.result: Compile Error: Syntax error! Line 1: --> NPrint "Edited Hello from Blitz!"+.

Requester dismissed, but subsequent run showed only Compiled, not interpreted. Inspection in PED found first line blank. This was an input/edit failure, not a successful repair. A held Shift state is suspected after earlier shifted filename input; mechanism not established.
Did not restore the first line.

observations.action: Release both Shift modifiers with a chord, retype corrected first line in PED and inspect all four statements; compile
observations.result: Console showed Edited Hello from Blitz! and Compiled, not interpreted. while waiting. Actual repaired output verified.
Returned to four-line edited source, no trailing plus. Full bounded console loop completed.
